message: You know, I’ve always believed that being a little too prepared is better than not prepared at all—especially when those storm clouds start rolling in. I stumbled across some handy tips on thunderstorms recently, and they’re worth a peek if you want to feel like the most gloriously over-prepared person on the block. Remember, it’s all about staying cozy and calm while Mother Nature does her thing. What’s your favorite stormy day activity? 🌧️
